questions.q_en: Which Excel function helps find data in a large dataset based on a reference value?
questions.solution_en:
VLOOKUP (Vertical Lookup) is designed specifically for this purpose. It searches for a value in the leftmost column of a range and then returns a value in the same row from a specified column. It's incredibly useful for looking up data in tables.

Other options:

· SUMIF: Sums values based on a criterion.

· COUNT: Counts the number of cells that contain numbers.

· AVERAGE: Calculates the average of a set of numbers.

Column AColumn B

questions.q_en: What is the keyboard shortcut for Paste Special in Excel?
questions.solution_en:
Ctrl + Alt + V opens Paste Special dialog for advanced paste options.

Paste Special gives you more control over how you paste data. You can choose to paste only values, formats, formulas, etc.

Ctrl + V is the standard paste, but Ctrl + Alt + V gives you the advanced options.

questions.q_en: Which feature in Word automatically updates all similarly formatted text when changes are made?
questions.solution_en: Styles are a powerful way to manage formatting in Word. If you apply a style to a section of text, and then modify that style, all text using that style will update automatically. This ensures consistency and makes large document formatting much easier.
